body:
MAINLINE-011 check. The four limits agree. At s 3 m, r_o 86.6 mm and t_w 2.25 mm, Euler is 0.2333, yield 0.2331, local 0.908 and film 0.838. An own scan on the 0.02 m grid finds that point, and the same best values for T700 0.765, M55J 0.487, K13D2U 0.287, SiC 2.849 at s 0.88, and CNT 1.949 at s 1.28. The fixed r_o 0.02 m row matches 005: wall 3.497 mm, Euler 0.0960, yield 0.2319. Against P2-E the ratios are 0.997 at kd 0.2 and 1.417 at kd 0.1407.

The member is an axial column of length s. The card does not say arc or straight. A straight chord at that point sags 112.5 mm, past the 86.6 mm radius, and no bending term is carried. No global mode is carried; NFI-011-GLOBAL says so. The follow-on brief's two-way expression is a perfect SF 0.704 here. A triangular coefficient was not sourced. One prose miss: at r_o 0.02 m, K13D2U is yield-bound at 0.285, with Euler at 0.405. SiC's film becomes the least limit at s 0.90, SF 2.793, rather than only at s 1. Tags are present. These objections do not stop the card.
